_comment: Bundled fallback sample of representative first-turn user prompts in the spirit of the WildChat dataset (Zhao et al., 2024). The paper samples real prompts from WildChat; we cannot redistribute that dataset here, so wildchat.py will load it from Hugging Face (allenai/WildChat-1M) when `datasets` is installed and a HF token is available, and otherwise fall back to this hand-written sample. These are deliberately ordinary, open-ended task requests across coding, writing, factual, and creative domains. See DESIGN.md.
prompts: Write a short professional email asking my manager for a day off next Friday.
Explain how photosynthesis works in simple terms.
Give me a recipe for a quick vegetarian dinner using rice and chickpeas.
Write a Python function that checks whether a string is a palindrome.
Summarize the plot of Hamlet in three sentences.
Suggest five names for a small indie coffee shop.
Translate 'Where is the nearest train station?' into Spanish and German.
Draft a polite message declining a meeting invitation due to a scheduling conflict.
What are some good stretches to do after sitting at a desk all day?
Write a haiku about autumn leaves.
Explain the difference between TCP and UDP.
Give me three tips for improving my time management.
Write a SQL query to find the top 5 customers by total order value.
Describe the water cycle for a 10-year-old.
Suggest a one-week itinerary for a first-time visitor to Tokyo.
Write a cover letter opening paragraph for a junior data analyst role.
What is the difference between machine learning and deep learning?
Help me brainstorm gift ideas for my dad who likes gardening and jazz.
Write a regular expression that matches a valid email address.
Explain compound interest with a simple numerical example.
